def comps_of(g):
    nz=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x]
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for z in nz:
        if z in seen: continue
        stack=[z]; comp=set()
        while stack:
            p=stack.pop()
            if p in comp: continue
            comp.add(p); seen.add(p)
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                nb=(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc)
                if nb in nz and nb not in comp: stack.append(nb)
        out.append(sorted(comp))
    return out
def norm(c):
    r0=min(p[0] for p in c); c0=min(p[1] for p in c)
